notLinked.title: Access pending
notLinked.message: Your user isn't linked to an active DOQYN workspace yet. Ask your company administrator for an invitation.

pending.title: Awaiting approval
pending.message: Your access to this company hasn't been approved yet. The company administrator can take care of it.

blocked.title: Access blocked
blocked.message: Your access to this workspace has been blocked.

rejected.title: Access declined
rejected.message: Your access to this workspace was declined. Getting back in takes a new invitation from the company administrator.

removed.title: Access removed
removed.message: You're no longer part of this DOQYN workspace. Getting back in takes a new invitation from the company administrator.

noMembership.title: No active access
noMembership.message: Your account doesn't have active access to any DOQYN workspace yet.

uploadQueue.stillRunning: The analysis continues on the server. The document shows up in the Library when it's done, with no need to upload it again.
uploadQueue.pollFailure: We lost contact with the server during the analysis. The document may have been processed. Check the Library before uploading again.
uploadQueue.groqDailyLimit: The Groq model's daily token quota is exhausted. Wait for the reset (~1h) or change GROQ_MODEL to openai/gpt-oss-20b.
uploadQueue.contextLimit: The document is too large for the current model. Reduce the PDF size or adjust PDF_ANALYSIS_MAX_INPUT_CHARS.
uploadQueue.timeout: The automatic analysis took too long and was stopped. Try again.
uploadQueue.rateLimit: Temporary Groq limit reached. Wait a few minutes and try again.
uploadQueue.missingJobId: Analysis identifier missing. Upload the document again.
uploadQueue.missingCategory: Classification missing. Choose a category to save this document.

validation.tooManyFiles: Select up to {{count}} documents at a time in this version.
validation.unsupportedFormat: Upload a PDF or an image (JPG, PNG or WebP) at this step.

workflowError.retrySuggestion: Try again. If the problem persists, contact support.
workflowError.rulesNotConfigured: Document setup is incomplete. Register classes and rules before analyzing documents.
